title: Plan-time cost & risk annotator with Conftest/OPA advisor for VPC IaC
creator: Aisha Raman
description: Goal: Surface cost and policy risk annotations during the Terraform plan step for private VPC deployments and run Policy-as-Code checks (Conftest + OPA) as an advisory layer in CI. This ticket implements a plan-time advisory agent that enriches terraform plan output with: 1) estimated monthly cost deltas (per-resource and total) using the internal pricing catalog, 2) risk tags derived from Conftest/OPA rules (eg. wide-open security groups, missing flow logs, unencrypted volumes), and 3) policy guidance links and remediation hints. The annotated plan should be human-readable in CI logs and emitted as a structured artifact (compact markdown + JSON metadata) for the Console to ingest into preflight dashboards. The advisor should be non-blocking by default (advisory mode) and configurable to fail pipelines above configurable severity thresholds.
acceptance_criteria: CI pipeline step `iac:plan-advisor` runs after `terraform plan` and produces a markdown advisory artifact and a compact JSON summary in the build artifacts
Advisory contains per-resource estimated monthly cost delta and total cost delta using the current pricing catalog (rounded and labeled with currency)
Conftest/OPA rules applied to plan output produce categorized findings: info | warning | critical, with remediation guidance and rule identifiers
Pipeline remains advisory by default; pipeline failure can be toggled by repo-level `iac.policy.fail_threshold` (info/warning/critical) and by org policy via feature flag
Advisory artifact links to relevant docs/PRs and GitHub files to speed remediation (eg. module docs, security playbook)
Console ingests advisory JSON and displays a preflight advisory widget in the VPC deployment UI in staging (integration spike validated)
Unit tests for the cost estimator and rule runner with >80% coverage of new logic paths
Documentation (README) for repo owners describing how to opt-in to strict failure and how to author local Conftest policies
tasks: Spike: evaluate third-party and internal pricing sources for per-resource estimates (done)
Implement `plan-advisor` CLI that parses `terraform show -json` and maps resources to pricing SKU
Integrate Conftest/OPA runner to evaluate the JSON plan and produce normalized findings
Design advisory JSON schema and markdown renderer for CI logs
Add feature flag and repo-level config to toggle fail threshold and advisory levels
Wire CI step into existing IaC pipeline (circleci/gitlab action) as non-blocking by default
Add Console ingestion endpoint and staging dashboard widget (hand-off to Console team)
Create unit and e2e tests for the advisor, include sample plans for common VPC patterns
Author docs and examples for repos to opt into strict failures and to write Conftest rules
notes: Spike findings: internal pricing catalog covers ~92% of our commonly used private VPC resource types. Missing pieces will default to 'unpriced' and appear as a note in the advisory.
We will start with Conftest using Rego policies checked into `iac/policies/` in each repo. Central rules will live in `infra-iac/policies/` and be included via CI fetch step.
Canonical rule set suggestion: security groups, public subnets, lack of flow logs, ebs unencrypted, wide IAM policies, sprawling NAT gateway counts.
Opt-in strictness: repos can commit `.iacrc` with `policy_fail_threshold: warning` to treat warnings as failures. Default remains advisory (info only).
Console ingestion: initial MVP will accept advisory JSON via signed webhook. Will iterate to signed S3 artifact ingest if needed.
We should coordinate with Security for classification of rules as 'must-fail' vs 'advisory' before flipping any org-level thresholds.
